meta.notes: Pins the 34h Emptied->Off wedge fix (dryer_monitor.py:1498-1506): 52 of 92 door-closes since January were refused because the old code ran DOOR_CLOSED from Emptied through the SAME unforced cooling check as everything else. The engine's cooling matrix (spec 3.3) makes EventClass.PHYSICAL unconditionally BYPASS cooling, so a door-close arriving well inside cooling_period must still land. This tape enters Emptied 5s before boot (state_since = anchor - 5s) and closes the door only 5s after that (t=5, cooling_period=600s) - a naive unforced gate would refuse this outright; the bypass must let it through immediately.
